title: Was anyone on an airplane in their dreams just before they woke up?
content: I was totally having a lucid dream where I climbed out of an airplane window (not an emergency exit) and was chilling on the horizontal stabilizer. I remember trying to talk to people through the window, but they couldn't hear me, so I took a pencil and wrote "is it okay if I sit here while we land" on the window in reverse. Strange dream, but the stress woke me up.
